card.name: Personal ties and stakes in a place
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about having connections or a stake somewhere, such as relatives "in" a country, "vested interest", "know anyone", or "few ties". It fires on the word where the connection is named or about to be named.

modes.label: Relatives and ties
modes.description: Words in phrases about having family, acquaintances or ties in a place or to the past.
modes.example: left our people with few<< ties>> to the past.

modes.label: Vested interest
modes.description: The word "in" or "interest" after "vested", marking a stake in something.
modes.example: vested interest<< in>> developing Africa’s infrastructure

modes.label: Knowing no one
modes.description: Words after "did not know" or "nor does he know", where a person is said to know nobody.
modes.example: where I did not know<< anyone>>. Yet my experience
